content.title: Coachella 2026: How To Watch Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, Karol G & More
content.text: Skip to main content Coachella 2026: How To Watch Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, Karol G & More The 2026 Coachella Music and Arts Festival kicks off Friday, the start of two weekends of music in the Southern California desert that will include headlining performances by Sabrina Carpenter on Friday, Justin Bieber on Saturday and Karol G on Sunday. The festival is providing livestreams from each of its eight stage venues at Indio’s Empire Polo Club via YouTube. Each day’s streams (for both April 10-12 and April 17-19) begin at 4 p.m. PT. Related Stories In Weekend 1, Carpenter caps a Friday schedule that includes Teddy Swims, Moby, Bini, Sexxy Red, Devo, Swae Lee, Katseye and Groove Armada. On Saturday, The Strokes and Addison Rae hit the main stage before Bieber, among they day’s schedule that includes David Byrne, Interpol, Sombr, Jack White and David Guetta. On Sunday, Karol G wraps a main-stage set that includes Young Thug and Major Lazer, with other sets to include Laufey, FKA Twigs, Foster the People, Gigi Perez, Izzy Pop, Black Flag, Suicidal Tendencies and Fatboy Slim. Check out the complete schedule here that includes artists, stage and scheduled time. Click above for the main stage livestream, with the rest of the stages’ livestreams below.
